scripts.dev:rs: cd apps/crm-server && cargo watch -w src -w ../../crates -w Cargo.toml -x 'run -p crm-server'
scripts.start: pnpm build:web && cargo build --release -p crm-server && cd apps/crm-server && STATIC_DIR=../../apps/crm-fe/dist ../../target/release/crm-server
scripts.auth:dev-keys: cargo build --release -p dev-tools --quiet && cd apps/crm-server && ../../target/release/dev-tools gen-keys
scripts.mint-token: cargo build --release -p dev-tools --quiet && cd apps/crm-server && ../../target/release/dev-tools mint-token
scripts.seed:admin: cargo build --release -p dev-tools --quiet && cd apps/crm-server && ../../target/release/dev-tools seed-admin
scripts.create:user: cargo build --release -p dev-tools --quiet && cd apps/crm-server && ../../target/release/dev-tools create-user
